summary: Tested the mobile-only font-size reduction on /termos.html (?c=pmpe and ?c=cbmpe) with Playwright at 390x844, 375x667 and 1400x900. Every requested check passed. Mobile: all 4 .termos-lista li are 12.48px (0.78rem), line-height 16.85px (1.35), padding 9.6px 12px 9.6px 38.4px. The ::before badge is 20.8x20.8px (1.3rem). .termos-lead is 14.4px and .termos-aceite is 13.12px. Nothing overflows (scrollWidth == clientWidth, li scrollWidth <= clientWidth) and all 4 items are fully readable. Desktop 1400x900 is unchanged: li 15.2px (0.95rem, the original base value), badge 24px, lead 17.6px, aceite 15.2px. Brasões render at both viewports (pmpe-logo.jpg naturalWidth 300, cbmpe-logo.jpg naturalWidth 80). No JS page errors or console errors. One minor cosmetic issue on mobile: the number badge sits about 8px higher than the first line of text.

ui_bugs.issue: The mobile rule sets top:.6rem but does not reset the base transform:translateY(-50%). The badge is moved up by a further 10.4px: its top lands at about -0.8px (just above the li's top edge) and its center sits about 8px above the center of the first text line. This is visible in the screenshots: the badges look higher than the text. Fix: add transform:none to `.termos-lista li::before` inside @media (max-width:767px), or keep top:50% and drop the top:.6rem override.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Add transform:none to the mobile `.termos-lista li::before` rule so the number badge lines up with the first line of text.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile ::before override sets top but inherits transform:translateY(-50%) from the base rule, so the badge is misaligned.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (1 low cosmetic issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: /termos.html never reaches networkidle (it keeps a connection open, probably the chat widget), so use wait_until='load'. Base desktop li font-size is 0.95rem (15.2px), not 1rem. The mobile overrides are in @media (max-width:767px) in /app/frontend/public/termos.html.
